●● ＲＧと統一感のある成形色カラー ＆ 新規デザインの‘リアリスティックデカール’が付属！！ ●●
※この商品に付属するリアリスティックデカールに、箔は使用していません。

en: Enjoy docking with RG 1/144 Gundam Exia (sold separately)! HG GN Arms is available as a single product in real color Ver. Introducing! !
*"RG 1/144 Gundam Exia" sold separately is a 20144 in-store Release Scheduled product.
●● Comes with a molded color that is consistent with RG & a newly designed 'realistic decal'! ! ●●
*No foil is used in the realistic decals included with this product.
From "Mobile Suit Gundam 00", the HG 1/144 series GN Arms is now available in real color Ver. commercialized as.
- Changed the molding color to have a unified feel with the RG main body.
- Newly designed realistic decal included. (*There is no marking using foil.)
- Molds are applied to various parts of the aircraft, achieving both the power of a large model that can be enjoyed with the RG main body installed, and a design full of precision.
- Equipped with a large GN sword, GN beam gun, and large GN cannon, and can transform into GN armor form. - Comes with a dedicated stand.
《The series of this product is “HG 1/144”》
《This product does not include the MS body》
This product can be jointed with applicable HG series MS as well as RG series applicable MS. In addition, the MS to be installed is sold separately.
Joint compatible kit *As of 20144
・RG 1/144 Gundam Exia (Target age: 15 years old or older)
・HG 1/144 Gundam Exia (Target age: 8 years old or older)
**Also available for products using the same 'Gundam Exia' body with different kit colors.
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE/ABS
・No adhesive is used for the assembly. *A + (Phillips) screwdriver (sold separately) is required for the assembly.
*The finished product in the photo is painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
[Posted in 201449] Product material information has been updated (ABS has been added)
[About sales price]
*Due to the consumption tax increase, the tax rate for products shipped after 20144 will be 8%.
(remarks)
・This product cannot be purchased at stores that carry plastic models.
・This product may be sold at events sponsored by our company or other projects.
・ There is a limited number of this product available for sale at 'Premium Bandai'. Please note that the item may be out of stock.
・Due to the application status and the number of production preparations, the quantity that can be purchased per person is limited for this product.
Thank you for your understanding.
・Product images are under development and may differ from the actual product.
- Product specifications are scheduled as of 20143. Please note that there may be changes.
